fee_notes: The standard Initial Franchise Fee is $40,000 per individual Store, due via ACH upon signing the Franchise Agreement and is non-refundable. During 2025, fees actually received ranged from $20,000 to $40,000. Under the MSD Agreement, a $20,000 Development Fee is paid per additional Store (excluding the first), which is credited against the then-current initial franchise fee for each subsequent Store. An additional non-refundable Initial Opening Support Fee of $20,000 is also required at signing (separate from the Initial Franchise Fee). Honorably discharged veterans receive a $20,000 product credit from the franchisor's affiliate, usable within one year of opening, applicable only to the first Store.
raw_excerpt: The "Initial Franchise Fee" for an individual SCOOTER'S COFFEE Store is $40,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is due and payable by an Automated Clearing House network transfer ("ACH") when you sign the Franchise Agreement and is not refundable. During 2025, we received initial franchise fees ranging from $20,000 to $40,000.
